cases.description: 1996-03-07 Chennai. Chosen over the Dec ref-chart: the December input lands on a sankranti whose Tamil-month assignment sits exactly on the solar-month boundary, so arcsec ephemeris drift (JPL vs Moshier) flips the integer tamil_month and (via the `multiple` target) the inverse-Lagrange sankranti time. The March sankranti is interior, so both runtimes agree on date and tamil_month; only a ~1e-5 hr time drift remains.

tolerance_rationale: Sankranti time (float hours) from inverse-Lagrange root-search on solar longitude: sub-arcsec ephemeris drift (Python FLG_SWIEPH/JPL vs TS WASM FLG_MOSEPH). Discrete date/tamil_month/tamil_day match exactly at this interior (non-boundary) case.
